analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일간 6.82% 상승 후 2일 전 -10.44%, 3일 전 -9.46% 급락으로 변동성 확대. RSI는 44.8에서 38.8로 하락하며 과매도 구간 진입 실패. MACD 히스토그램은 23015에서 -9785로 악화되며 약세 지속. ADX 24.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계이나 -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우위. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.37배로 위축되어 있어 상승 동력 부족. 52주 저가 대비 28.7% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준이나, 단기 반등 시도 실패 후 약세 전환 가능성 높아 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Recent volatility with a +6.82% gain followed by sharp drops of -10.44% and -9.46% in the past 5 trading days. RSI declined from 44.8 to 38.8, failing to exit oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 23015 to -9785, indicating continued weakness. ADX at 24.1 suggests an early trend formation, but -DI is above +DI, showing downward pressure. Trading volume at 0.37x the 5-day average is subdued, lacking upward momentum. The price is at 28.7% of its 52-week range, still low, but the failed short-term rebound attempt increases the likelihood of a bearish reversal, thus a wait-and-see approach is warranted.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($1,213,500) below SMA5 ($1,228,300), SMA20 ($1,315,275), and SMA50 ($1,570,683): diagnosing short-to-medium term trend as weak.
· Below SMA100 ($1,775,187) and SMA200 ($1,511,489): confirming long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (28.7%) + potential approach to historical low levels.
[Momentum Indicators]

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.37x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): potential for bearish reversal after failed short-term rebound attempt, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
